description: Restrict the naming series offered on a transaction to the ones assigned to its Company.

fields.description: When enabled, the Naming Series dropdown of a new document only offers the series assigned below to the document's Company, and the server rejects any other series. A series assigned to a company is hidden from every other company; a company with no rows only sees the series nobody has claimed. Document Types with no rows below are not affected. When disabled nothing changes.
fields.label: Enable Company-wise Naming Series
Help
fields.options: Add one row per Document Type, Company and Naming Series. Tick Default on the series a new document of that company should start with. A series must already exist in the Document Type's naming series options (Setup > Naming Series) before it can be assigned here. Per-user restrictions from Naming Series Per User still apply on top of these.

name: Isoft Naming Series Settings
